scene: The hatch opens to reveal three strange transit docks below the roof.
picture: Side-view pixel art along a transit deck. Far left, a brass carousel train shaped like mechanical beasts idles. Left, the Pacific Islander girl holds popcorn with sketchbook tucked. Centre, an upright glass pneumatic tube pod waits open. Far right, a large iridescent bubble lift hovers above an open railing hatch.
shown: a winding brass carousel train waiting on tracks at the far left
a clear glass pneumatic capsule glowing brightly at the centre
